fixed.summary: Text over scifi's glass holds 4.5:1 over the brightest and darkest scenes. The band, frame-top and inset cyan washes are thinner (a band peaks at 12 %), the light scheme's white frost is denser (about 90 %) and its selected-tab amber wash thinner, and the dark label, done, gold, XP, legendary and trend-down inks are lighter (the light ones deeper) so they read on glass with the scene behind it.
